name: Button

representativeVariants.name: Primary — large
representativeVariants.whySelected: The homepage's main reading CTA is a black, square-cornered action with generous horizontal padding.

representativeVariants.name: Secondary — large
representativeVariants.whySelected: The paired About CTA reverses the same black-and-white rule while keeping the heavy outline visible.

representativeVariants.name: Utility — square
representativeVariants.whySelected: The visible theme toggle is a 36px square utility control with a 2px border and no fill.

representativeVariants.name: Ghost — compact
representativeVariants.whySelected: Dense nav links use transparent surfaces and become filled only when the route is active.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use one filled primary action per major section; use the secondary outline beside it and compact controls for utilities.
usageHints.a11y: Keep a visible focus ring, preserve a minimum 36px target for utility controls, and provide an accessible label for icon-only buttons.

unknowns: The exact disabled-state opacity was not visible on the public homepage.
